summary: Iteration-6 frontend bug fix verified on /harcamalar page. All 6 scenarios in review request passed: (1) New dialog shows the 3 category buttons (Şirket/Murat/Özkan) with none pre-selected and matching data-testids. (2) Save disabled + inline rose validation text 'Harcamanın kime ait olduğunu seçmelisiniz.' appears when category not chosen (even with name+amount filled). (3) Adding spending with a category different from the active tab auto-switches the UI to the destination tab and shows the new row with success toast. (4) Edit flow pre-selects the current category, shows amber 'kayıt ... sekmesine taşınacak' hint when category changed, saves and auto-switches to destination tab; row no longer visible in source tab. (5) Edit without category change does not show amber hint and does not switch tabs. (6) Murat->Şirket move verified end-to-end. Delete regression works and tab totals recompute correctly. Backend was not re-tested (no backend change this iteration; iter-5 pytest file still valid).

issues: Radix a11y warning in console: Missing Description or aria-describedby on DialogContent (non-blocking).

critical_code_review_comments: Harcamalar.jsx is well structured (~271 lines). Save handler correctly guards on !form.category and shows toast fallback in addition to disabled button.
Minor: DialogContent lacks aria-describedby — add a DialogDescription for a11y to silence the Radix warning.
Minor: toast.error on missing category is unreachable because the save button is disabled while form.category is empty — defensive check is fine, but can be noted.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ozkan_add and TEST_murat_move spendings during flow verification; both deleted at end of test. No residual seed data remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Harcamalar page category-selector + auto-tab-switch behavior fully verified via Playwright against preview URL. data-testids present: spending-add-btn, spending-tab-{company|user1|user2}, spending-form-category-group, spending-form-category-{company|user1|user2}, spending-form-name, spending-form-amount, spending-form-date, spending-form-save, spending-row-{id}, spending-edit-{id}, spending-delete-{id}, spending-total-{cat}. Only noticeable (non-blocking) issue is a Radix a11y warning about missing DialogDescription.
